CREATIVE ARTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

3. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

5. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)

   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Photography.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Photography.

7. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.

8. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.

9. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

11. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)

14. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   C. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

15. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.

----
